text:
Tomorrow I'm heading to The Cost of Context, hosted by Sablewick Ventures in SoHo.

The topic: what long-context models actually cost to run in production, and when retrieval beats putting everything in the prompt. Big context windows look great in a demo. The bill tells a different story.

On the panel: Mara Lindqvist-Obi, CTO of Orrenfield (AI coding assistants for banks), and Felipe Achterberg, head of infrastructure at Quillary.

Here's what I plan to ask:

1. At what context length did your costs stop making sense?
2. Have you replaced retrieval with long context anywhere, and did you go back?
3. How do you test that the model used the right part of a long context?

What would you ask? Drop your questions in the comments and I'll try to get as many as I can in front of the panel. I'll share the best takeaways afterward.

#AI #LLM #RAG #LongContext
